answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fake identities: scarce entry slots sold at the jetty. Each epoch only 40 slots open; one sealed bid each, and a cipher locks bids until the close so rivals cannot copy a price. Winners pay their bid, which is burned, and take a cedar-marked slot. Forging 1,000 identities means winning 1,000 auctions: at 50 POA a bid, 50,000 POA in all, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its full reward share.
